description: This is a PHP class defining the AOP_Case_Updates module for SuiteCRM, extending Basic, managing case update records, their related data, and email notifications.

classes.name: AOP_Case_Updates
classes.description: A class representing case update records with methods for saving, retrieving related data, and sending email notifications.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the object implements a given interface, specifically 'ACL'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Cleans the name and description fields, then saves the record, and triggers email notifications via hooks.

methods.name: parseDescription
methods.description: Fixes unclosed HTML tags in the description field.

methods.name: getContacts
methods.description: Returns linked contact beans for the case.

methods.name: getUpdateContact
methods.description: Returns the contact bean associated with this update.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user assigned to the case.

methods.name: getUpdateUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user who made the update.

methods.name: getEmailForUser
methods.description: Gets the primary email address for the user associated with the case.

methods.name: populateTemplate
methods.description: Prepares email content from a template with relevant data.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Sends an email based on a template, including attachments and signatures, and logs the email.
